join.githubRepositoryId: optional stable provider identity when acquisition exposes it

invariants: assessment.json is a generated projection and not the authority for taxonomy or evidence sources
generatorRevision identifies generator code while observedAt identifies subject observation time
repositoryKey is unique within an artifact
owned repositories join graph nodes through repository:<name>
contributed repositories join graph nodes through repository:<owner/name>
ownership collaboration and lineage are orthogonal relation axes
fork is lineage and never substitutes for ownership or collaboration
L0 owned non-fork repositories default collaboration to unknown rather than solo
productionScoring is false while production weights and tiers are unfrozen
productionScore remains null in v1 experimental artifacts
missing sections remain explicit rather than being converted to numeric zero
personal prominence remains null when gated Personal Contribution is unknown
personal prominence remains null while owned collaboration attribution is unresolved
raw activity does not become a prominence input
stable reusable v1 release does not move merely because this contract changes
